is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates field populations of Anopheles epiroticus (page 1, Abstract; page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No molecular resistance markers were genotyped in this study; the authors only cite previous literature stating kdr is absent in An. epiroticus in this region (page 2, Background; page 7, Discussion).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data or allele counts are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Van Duc A village, Bac Lieu province, southern Vietnam (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating ITNs and LLINs in experimental huts (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Van Duc A village, Bac Lieu province, southern Vietnam (9.18353 N, 105.30339 E) (page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Baseline was conducted in December 2006 and the hut trial took place from 23 September to 28 October 2008 (page 3, Study design).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary experimental hut evaluation trial.

supplement.evidence: No supplemental marker data exists or is referenced.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of insecticide-treated nets (PermaNet 2.0, PermaNet 3.0, and deltamethrin CTN) against wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles epiroticus in experimental huts in Bac Lieu province, southern Vietnam. The study did not test African populations nor did it perform molecular genotyping for resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: No target insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped.
